messages:
sasha: quick ping 14E2 security wants to tighten partner SIEM export retention from 30d -> 7d for external consumers. This touches RBAC, KMS unwrap, and the export runbook. any immediate blockers?
raj: what's the risk appetite change? compliance-led?
emily: From IR side shorter TTL is OK, but we need a formal snapshot handoff flow so analysts can still get targetted forensic snapshots during an active investigation. who authorizes and how long can we 'extend' for triage?
security-engineer: Compliance requested 7d to reduce third-party data exposure window. Proposed controls: 1) per-export TTL enforced by export service, 2) ticket-based approval required for any non-default TTL, 3) KMS unwrap must be proxied and tied to ticket-scoped ephemeral tokens.
raj: we'll need RBAC split: internal exports keep 30d, external partner exports limited to 7d. Also add alerting when someone tries to request >7d for external.
sasha: sketch role: siem.partner_exporter (max_ttl=7d, requires_ticket=true, destinations=[partner-s3, partner-gcs]). internal role siem.ops retains legacy TTL.
security-engineer: dev-tested policy example (pseudo):
```json
{
  "role": "siem.partner_exporter",
  "max_ttl": "7d",
  "requires": ["ticket_id","approver"],
  "actions": ["export:create","export:download"]
}
```
emily: KMS: analysts should not unwrap keys directly. plan: kms-proxy validates ticket+approver, mints one-time unwrap token scoped to destination label, token is single-use and expires in 10m. audit event: kms_proxy.unwrap {ticket, requester, dest}.
raj: can we reuse the existing kms-proxy used by forensics snapshots? if yes, it's a small flag to flip. if not, add a scoped-label check.
security-engineer: yes reuseable, needs dest-scoping check and audit fields. also add metric for unwrap attempts and failed approvals.
oncall-bot: approval recorded: raj approved policy change SEC-512 at 12:17 UTC :white_check_mark:
sasha: rollout checklist: 1) create new IAM roles/policies in prod 2) exporter service enforces per-export TTL and ticket validation 3) kms-proxy adds destination scoping + single-use token 4) alerting for >max_ttl requests 5) update runbook (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-exports) 6) QA in staging with partner-s3 test data
emily: please add a runbook step for emergency extension: require SEC-incident ticket, 2nd approver from legal, and an auditable justification field.
raj: no blockers from infra. curious about migration: do we auto-classify existing partner exports older than 7d? i think they should be grandfathered until rotation.
security-engineer: we will not retroactively delete existing exports. plan: new policy enforced on new exports only. we will run a one-off inventory and contact partners with >7d datasets to negotiate removal.
sasha: I'll open RFC + PR with policy JSON + kms-proxy patch. target staging rollout tomorrow, prod mid-week pending sign-off. will paste links when ready.
raj: thanks, please tag me on PR for the IAM changes.
security-engineer: will include audit schema in PR (audit fields: ticket_id, approver, requester, dest, unwrap_token_id).
sasha: thanks all, will follow up in thread when PR live.
